subject.title: perf: use a focused OpenClaw prepack profile for diagnostics

question: Should Kova's diagnostic local-build profile use a narrower OpenClaw package than the normal release-shaped package, and which artifacts must remain mandatory?
rationale: Selecting omissions changes what Kova claims to validate, and the issue provides neither a package specification nor evidence establishing an acceptable boundary.

options.title: Specify and benchmark a focused contract
options.body: Define mandatory contents and require diagnostic scenario equivalence before switching the profile.

options.title: Keep the full release package
options.body: Preserve the current artifact and reduce build-cache or harness overhead without changing what Kova tests.

recommendation.title: Specify and benchmark a focused contract
recommendation.body: Define mandatory contents and require diagnostic scenario equivalence before switching the profile.

likelyOwner.reason: This member owns the issue and the closest merged diagnostic-performance work.
